The image features a colossal parabolic dish antenna constructed from a metal mesh surface supported by an intricate white steel lattice truss structure. The dish is mounted on a large, complex alt-azimuth support tower with visible mechanical gearing and walkways. In the foreground, there are green bushes and grass; in the background, trees and a cloudy sky. The scale is emphasized by the dwarfing of the surrounding vegetation.
